verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented power envelope (TDP, sustained clocks under ML workloads) from NVIDIA nor any independent performance-per-watt benchmarking specific to ML/AI compute workloads; the only perf-per-watt data point (comm-3) is a gaming-context comparison suggesting the 5080 is actually less efficient than the 4080 Super, not a positive substantiation of ML power efficiency. missing for 10: official power envelope/TDP documentation, independent sustained-workload benchmarking, ML-specific performance-per-watt testing.
